articles.title: The Exhibit That Carried a Load
articles.text: For an engineering exhibit, three students built a bridge from paper and recorded its manufacture on every page of a notebook. The bridge had to carry weights through a narrow passage while cameras watched its centre bend upward and downward. Their measurements did not correspond at first, because one sensor began to generate heat and produced a false reading that could have caused an injury. The final design was born from that failure: they moved the sensor, repeated the test, and explained the mistake beside the exhibit.
articles.translation: 为了工程展览，三名学生用纸造了一座桥，并在笔记本的每一页记录制造过程。纸桥必须在狭窄通道中承受重物，摄像机记录桥中央上下弯曲。起初测量结果互不对应，因为一个传感器发热并产生错误读数，可能导致人员受伤。最终设计从这次失败中诞生：他们移动传感器、重做试验，并在展品旁解释错误。

articles.title: Why Turbine Blades Have a Shape
articles.text: A turbine blade turns when moving air places a different load on its curved and flatter surfaces. Engineers run a live trial with smoke so they can see where air changes direction instead of leaving performance to chance. Air density changes with temperature, so a design for an east coast may behave differently inland; even a passing goose becomes a safety factor. A considerate site manager will not beg a conductor to ignore vibration, because the electrical and mechanical systems must be tested together.
articles.translation: 当流动空气在叶片弯曲面与较平表面施加不同载荷时，涡轮叶片就会转动。工程师用烟雾进行现场试验，以观察空气在哪里转向，而不是把性能交给偶然。空气密度随温度变化，因此为东海岸设计的设备在内陆可能表现不同；甚至飞过的鹅也会成为安全因素。体谅他人的现场经理不会恳求负责人忽略振动，因为电气与机械系统必须一起测试。

articles.title: Manufacturing Needs Honest Risk Maps
articles.text: A logical safety diagram should show more than the shortest lane between a desk and the factory door. It must mark turbine noise, chemical storage, every emergency bed, and places where an unconscious worker could be hidden behind machinery. A conservative manager may keep the old plan because a typist has already printed copies for every house, but convenience is weak evidence. Workers who use the floor daily should revise the map, test each route, and record hazards that managers cannot see from an office.
articles.translation: 合乎逻辑的安全图不应只显示办公桌到工厂门口的最短通道。它必须标出涡轮噪声、化学品存放处、急救床位，以及昏迷工人可能被机器遮挡的位置。保守的经理可能因打字员已为每栋房屋打印副本而保留旧方案，但方便并不是有力证据。每天使用车间的工人应修改地图、测试每条路线，并记录管理者在办公室看不到的危险。
